modern: Take me and throw me where you will; for there I shall keep my divine part tranquil, that is, content, if it can feel and act in keeping with its proper constitution. Is this change of place a sufficient reason why my soul should be unhappy and worse than it was, downcast, puffed up, shrinking, frightened? And what will you find which is sufficient reason for this?
original: Take me and cast me where thou wilt; for there I shall keep my divine part tranquil, that is, content, if it can feel and act comformably to its proper constitution. Is this [change of place] sufficient reason why my soul should be unhappy and worse than it was, depressed, expanded, shrinking, affrighted? and what wilt thou find which is sufficient reason for this?
